metadata.title: Figures You Can Read on Paper
metadata.audience: Students and practitioners learning to use and report on AI systems
metadata.fellow: Janvi Chitroda, AI Data Engineer volunteer, Medhavy project, Humanitarians AI
metadata.source: inbox/term2-week11/term2-week11-video-content.md (Week 11); narration supplied verbatim and pre-approved by Janvi (2026-10-28)
metadata.note: Project update. Thesis: after Professor Gultepe could not read the figures in print, every figure and table was rebuilt under print rules (≥16px text on a 1000px canvas, no titles inside images, paper terms only), checked in two rounds, dashboard panels automated with Playwright, Table 2 funnel and Table 3 results with four new Wilson 95% intervals, a 7-sheet workbook (~87 live formulas, zero errors), and image swaps matched by content. The work is Janvi's. Only Professor Brown and Professor Gultepe may be named. Every on-screen number appears in the Week 11 source as written.

beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — Claude composer, ask lands answered. Required intro line + AI-narration disclosure.
beats.narration_text: Hi, I am Janvi and this video is about rebuilding our paper's figures and tables so they work in print. This narration is an AI-generated voice; the work is mine.

props.command: My reviewer can't read our paper's figures when printed. How should I rebuild them?
props.segment: Figures You Can Read on Paper.
output: Set a minimum text size for print
Check every figure at print size

beats.role_note: Quote card 'I cannot read the figures when printed.' — Professor Gultepe; 'rules for every figure'.
beats.narration_text: Professor Gultepe's comment was simple: she couldn't read the figures when printed. So I set rules for every figure.
beats.visual_intent: Quote card 'I cannot read the figures when printed.' — Professor Gultepe; 'rules for every figure'.

show.event: "I cannot read the figures when printed."

beats.role_note: Three rule cards: '≥ 16px text on a 1000px canvas' · 'no titles inside images' · 'paper terms only, old labels removed'.
beats.narration_text: At least 16 pixels of text on a 1,000-pixel canvas. No titles inside the images, since captions go below. And the paper's own terms throughout, with the old labels removed.
beats.visual_intent: Three rule cards: '≥ 16px text on a 1000px canvas' · 'no titles inside images' · 'paper terms only, old labels removed'.

beats.role_note: Figure thumbnails: Fig 1 architecture · Fig 2 decision logic · Fig S1 funnel · Fig 3 kappa heatmap · Fig 4 sensitivity by judge (last two 'matplotlib · 300 dpi'); 'round 1: 3 issues → round 2: all fixed'.
beats.narration_text: I rebuilt the architecture and decision-logic figures and the supplementary funnel, and made the kappa heatmap and the sensitivity chart in matplotlib at 300 dpi. Two rounds of checking caught three issues, then confirmed the fixes.
beats.visual_intent: Figure thumbnails: Fig 1 architecture · Fig 2 decision logic · Fig S1 funnel · Fig 3 kappa heatmap · Fig 4 sensitivity by judge (last two 'matplotlib · 300 dpi'); 'round 1: 3 issues → round 2: all fixed'.

beats.role_note: Four-panel grid (a)–(d): approved · junk · fix_definition · REVIEW; chip 'Playwright, headless Chromium'.
beats.narration_text: For the dashboard figure, I automated screenshots with Playwright: one approved example, one junk, one needing a fixed definition, and one sent to review, assembled into four labelled panels.
beats.visual_intent: Four-panel grid (a)–(d): approved · junk · fix_definition · REVIEW; chip 'Playwright, headless Chromium'.

beats.role_note: Table 2 funnel: 10,055 → −6 duplicates = 10,049 → −1,302 junk → −586 REVIEW → −338 fix_definition → +230 regenerated = 8,053 shipped.
beats.narration_text: Table 2 walks every item through the pipeline: 10,055 matched articles, minus six duplicates, minus the junk, review and fix-definition items, plus 230 returned from regeneration, to 8,053 shipped keywords.
beats.visual_intent: Table 2 funnel: 10,055 → −6 duplicates = 10,049 → −1,302 junk → −586 REVIEW → −338 fix_definition → +230 regenerated = 8,053 shipped.

beats.role_note: Table 3 card 'all experiments, one table'; chip '4 new Wilson 95% intervals'; workbook card '7 sheets · ~87 live formulas · zero errors'.
beats.narration_text: Table 3 puts every experiment's results in one place, with four new Wilson confidence intervals. Behind it is a seven-sheet data workbook with about 87 live formulas, recalculated with zero errors.
beats.visual_intent: Table 3 card 'all experiments, one table'; chip '4 new Wilson 95% intervals'; workbook card '7 sheets · ~87 live formulas · zero errors'.

beats.role_note: Eight thumbnails in order with ticks; chip 'matched by content, not filename'. (Split from Janvi's B07 so the handoff stays a pure composer beat; narration verbatim.)
beats.narration_text: The riskiest step was swapping images into the paper, so I identified each one by what it shows, not its filename, and checked all eight items were in order.
beats.visual_intent: Eight thumbnails in order with ticks; chip 'matched by content, not filename'. (Split from Janvi's B07 so the handoff stays a pure composer beat; narration verbatim.)
